Tom — looping in marketing for the final bits. Proposed copy (can be used as the quote-approval SLA and publicity clause):

"Publicity and Use of Marks: Customer grants Redwood a limited, non-exclusive, non-transferable license to use Customer's name, trademarks and logos (the 'Marks') solely in connection with marketing materials that reference the Parties' relationship as described in this Order Form. Redwood will only use the specific logo files provided by Customer and will comply with the Customer's brand guidelines. Prior to any public release, Redwood will provide Customer with proposed quote text and mock assets for review. Customer agrees to use commercially reasonable efforts to provide written approval or edits within three (3) business days of receipt. Following mutual written approval of a press release or joint announcement, neither Party will publicly disclose the announcement for a period of thirty (30) days (the 'Embargo Period') without the prior written consent of the other Party. Either Party may request an earlier release in writing, which the other Party may approve at its sole discretion."

I've attached a one-page checklist to make the sign-off quick. Tom — if that looks right, Ben and Kimberly will fold this into the order form and return a tracked PDF for legal review.
